title: N.C.R.B., (M.H.A.) PRISON STATISTICS - 1996 From the above table, it is evident that except Gujarat, Maharashtra, Orissa, Punjab and Delhi, in most of the States/UTs, very large number of women undertrials were released before completion of 1 year of detention period during the year 1996. Such release was 100% in Goa, Himachal Pradesh, Karnataka, Mizoram, Nagaland, Tripura, Andaman & Nicobar Island, Chandigarh, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Pondicherry.
